content_sections.heading: About IISER Thiruvananthapuram
content_sections.text: The Indian Institute of Science Education and Research Thiruvananthapuram describes itself as one of the premier science education and research institutes established by the Government of India in 2008. Its stated aim is to impart high-quality education integrated with outstanding research in modern science.

content_sections.heading: IISER Thiruvananthapuram Project Assistant Vacancy Details 2026
content_sections.text: Both posts serve the externally funded project "Modulation of Gene Expression by Replication-Transcription collisions in Bacteria / Cis-regulatory adaptation by replication-transcription collisions in bacteria". content_sections.heading: IISER Thiruvananthapuram Project Assistant Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: 50 years (preferably under 35 years). Bachelor's degree in Biological Sciences, as prescribed by the funding agency. The qualifying degree must be from a recognized University/Institution. The prescribed educational qualifications are the bare minimum, so include every relevant qualification and all experience in the application form. See the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

rows.desirable_experience: Standard molecular/microbial techniques; analyzing bacterial genomic data - WGS, RNAseq, etc.
Programming in Python, SQL, R; analyzing bacterial genomic data - WGS, RNAseq, ChIP-Seq, etc.; maintaining Linux-based computer servers

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Shortlisting: if the number of applications received is high, a Selection Committee shortlists candidates. Interview: shortlisted candidates receive the interview information by email.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: The tenure of the post is 3 years, with an initial appointment for 6 months and continuance upon satisfactory performance. The appointment is on contract and purely temporary. It will terminate automatically on closure of the research project, without any further notice or compensation. Appointment is governed by the terms and conditions laid down by the funding agency for the specific project and post. The appointed candidate has no right to claim appointment or absorption into the job supported by the funding agency or IISER Thiruvananthapuram, either during the project or after its closure. Selected candidates are required to join duty at the earliest on receipt of the offer letter.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IISER Thiruvananthapuram Project Assistant Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Open the official notice page and use its Application Form link. Fill in the form, mentioning all relevant qualifications and experience for the position. Submit the application by 9 November 2026. Selected candidates must submit the following to the Institute: A printed copy of the application form (the one sent by email), signed and dated by the applicant A recent passport size photograph One photocopy each of all relevant certificates and other testimonials in support of age, qualification and experience Originals of all certificates for verification of documents

faq.question: Q1. Who is funding this project?
faq.answer: The project is funded by ANRF and DBT, and the appointment follows the terms these funding agencies lay down.

faq.question: Q2. Is a Bachelor's degree enough to apply?
faq.answer: A Bachelor's degree in Biological Sciences meets the minimum, but shortlisting takes into account qualifications and experience above that minimum.

faq.question: Q3. What skills help for Post 02?
faq.answer: Post 02 lists programming in Python, SQL and R, bacterial genomic data analysis and maintaining Linux-based computer servers as desirable.

faq.question: Q4. Can a candidate over 35 apply?
faq.answer: Yes, the age limit is 50 years, although candidates under 35 years are preferred.

faq.question: Q5. How long will the appointment last?
faq.answer: The first appointment is for 6 months, and it can continue up to the 3-year tenure upon satisfactory performance.

faq.question: Q6. How will shortlisted candidates hear about the interview?
faq.answer: Interview information will be sent to them by email.

faq.question: Q7. Will travel costs for the interview be paid?
faq.answer: No, the notice says no Travelling Allowance or Dearness Allowance will be paid for attending.

faq.question: Q8. Does this job lead to a permanent post?
faq.answer: No, the appointee has no right to claim absorption, and the appointment ends automatically when the research project closes.
